text:
incident_bot: [PAGER] polaris-ded-1/gpu-27 — rising ECC error rate and GPU thermal spikes, 3 tenants affected. Paging @mike_oncall and duty ops. Please acknowledge and triage.

mike_oncall: acked. pulling metrics now. what’s the observed qps impact? any customer tickets yet?

polaris_sre: we’ve got 429s from two prod apps and increased latency. customer-side SRE here, ticket opened: POL-789. They’re seeing degraded tail latency on embeddings calls.

jules_se: tagging in from SE — Polaris is on a reserved dedicated pool with strict SLOs. We need to avoid broad failover if we can do staged evacuation.

mike_oncall: got node telemetry. thermal jumps and ECC correctable errors accumulating -> kernel logs show repeated ECC events. Host looks unstable but still responding. plan: staggered drain of gpu-27 to avoid mass cache eviction. will move tenants one-by-one to polaris-ded-2 and route small canary traffic first.

leo_reliability: +1 for staged. rapid full pool drain could flush KV/prefix caches and spike upstream call costs. we should set routing policy to prefer backup pool with slow ramp.

mike_oncall: running health check and drain dry-run.

mike_oncall: ```
# check node status
dedpoolctl status --pool=polaris-ded-1 --node=gpu-27
# kernel log tail
journalctl -u gpu-manager -n 200 | grep -i ecc
``` 

incident_bot: Alert details: 2860012345 - metric: gpu.ecc.correctable.rate > 50/min, node: gpu-27, pool: polaris-ded-1, affected_tenants: [Polaris-AppA, Polaris-Embed, Polaris-Reporting]

tara_support: notifying Polaris account team and putting customer updates on the ticket. Polaris wants minimized request loss — prefer in-flight continuation rather than abrupt reject.

mike_oncall: starting staged migration. Step 1: mark node as drain-candidate and remove new placement targets.

mike_oncall: ```
# mark node
dedpoolctl annotate --pool=polaris-ded-1 --node=gpu-27 state=drain-candidate
# prevent new tenancy
dedpoolctl set-placer --pool=polaris-ded-1 --node=gpu-27 allow_new=false
``` 

ops_dispatch: scheduling a hardware replacement window but it’ll be ~90m ETA for on-site tech. we should plan for software-only mitigation.

mike_oncall: Step 2: migrate tenants in this order: Polaris-Embed (low state), Polaris-Reporting (batch), Polaris-AppA (latency-sensitive) — do smallest impact first. will do 5% canary to backup pool then 25% then 100% per tenant.

polaris_sre: appreciate the order. for Polaris-AppA, can we keep requests hitting the same model variant to avoid quality regressions? backups are s1-small-quant which is slightly lower perf but acceptable.

jules_se: we’ll set model fallback config for these tenants to pin to same model family. also copying KV cache prefixes where possible.

mike_oncall: executing canary for Polaris-Embed -> route 5% to polaris-ded-2.

mike_oncall: ```
# ramp route weight
routectl set-weight --tenant=Polaris-Embed --from=polaris-ded-1 --to=polaris-ded-2 --weight=5
# monitor
monitoring query "request.latency{tenant=Polaris-Embed,pool=polaris-ded-2}.p95"
``` 

leo_reliability: canary looks clean so far. no error rate increase. proceeding to 25%.

mike_oncall: 25% stable -> 100% moved for Polaris-Embed. initiating eviction on gpu-27 for that tenant.

mike_oncall: ```
dedpoolctl migrate --from=polaris-ded-1 --to=polaris-ded-2 --tenant=Polaris-Embed --mode=evacuate
``` 

tara_support: informing customer via POL-789: "We’re routing a small percentage to a backup pool and monitoring performance. No requests dropped expected." :white_check_mark:

mike_oncall: Polaris-Reporting batch moved next with similar 5/25/100 ramp. monitoring mem/cpu and ECC count.

incident_bot: Note — if ECC correctables turn into uncorrectable within 10 minutes, auto-evict policy will trigger full node quarantine. Keep eyes on XGM counters.

mike_oncall: observing ECC count: corrected went from 60 -> 95 in 12m. thermal baseline still high but stable. moving to Polaris-AppA canary.

polaris_sre: if AppA sees tail p99 regressions > 200ms we need to pause and consult.

mike_oncall: canary for Polaris-AppA at 5% now. p95/P99 metrics: p95 +12ms, p99 +30ms — within tolerances.

jules_se: cold cache for appA on backup pool may increase token cost; suggest short-lived cache pre-warm for expected prefixes.

mike_oncall: kicking cache warmup job for AppA prefixes.

mike_oncall: ```
# warm prefixes
cachectl warm --tenant=Polaris-AppA --pool=polaris-ded-2 --prefix-file=/tmp/appa-prefixes.txt
``` 

nora_account_mgr: I’m drafting the customer update to emphasize staged approach and ETA for hardware replacement. ETA 90m for physical swap. will include compensatory credit offer if SLO breached.

ops_dispatch: confirmed hardware ETA 88 minutes. we can keep using staggered software approach until replacement.

mike_oncall: migrating AppA to 100% now. Eviction initiated for gpu-27 after tenants are cleared.

mike_oncall: ```
# final eviction
dedpoolctl drain --pool=polaris-ded-1 --node=gpu-27 --force --evict-tenants
# quarantine
dedpoolctl annotate --pool=polaris-ded-1 --node=gpu-27 state=quarantined
``` 

incident_bot: Node gpu-27 moved to quarantined. Automated capacity routing engaged: traffic now prefers polaris-ded-2 for affected tenants. No global failover.

polaris_sre: we see near-normal traffic now, thanks. minor spike in token usage but within review thresholds.

jules_se: created temporary routing policy and a rollback plan in case polaris-ded-2 shows capacity stress: route split back to hosted-api with 10% spill and throttle long-running requests.

mike_oncall: created internal incident channel #inc-2860012345-polaris. logging actions and runbook steps. assigned post-incident owner: leo_reliability. postmortem scheduled tomorrow 10:00 UTC.

tara_support: updated POL-789 with timeline and current mitigations. Polaris requesting timeline for root cause and preventive measures.

ops_dispatch: hardware tech on-site. replacing GPU board and re-running diagnostics. will report results in channel.

incident_bot: escalation timer set. next-oncall: @oncall_next will take handoff in 60m. mike, please post final handoff message.

mike_oncall: handing off now. Current status: gpu-27 quarantined, tenants fully migrated to polaris-ded-2, hardware replacement in progress (ETA ~60m), no visible customer-impacting errors. Oncall_next, you own until postmortem.

oncall_next: acked — will monitor and keep POL-789 updated. tagging leo_reliability for post-incident follow-up.

leo_reliability: will own the RCA and long-term remediation (validate ECC thresholds, improve auto-migration ramp, add early thermal throttling alarm). will include cost analysis of cache warmup vs failover in postmortem.

nora_account_mgr: Polaris update ready to send. Thank you all. Will request a follow-up meeting with Polaris ops.

polaris_sre: thanks team. appreciate the staged approach and the low-impact migration. Please let us know if anything else changes.

mike_oncall: closing thread for active triage. will re-open if uncorrectable ECCs or new alerts. :heavy_check_mark:
